name: Snake Arena
hook: Eat to grow. Make others crash into you.
how: Steer with the mouse or a finger and hold to boost. Hit another snake and you turn into food for everyone else.
controls: Mouse or touch to steer, hold or tap Boost to speed up
uses: Each player's longest snake, shown when you crash.
Bots fill the arena until enough people join.
Every snake moves for everyone at once.
ideas: Make it underwater, with fish instead of snakes
Add a speed pad in the middle of the map
Let players pick a skin before they join
